evidence: The workflow makes no external model/API calls; its steps write static status and feedback strings.
The commit job checks out main independently and does not download artifacts from prior jobs.
The commit job's git add Barrot-Agent/logs/ step reports a pathspec error because that generated path is absent in its fresh checkout.
The final git push reports no changes; no durable cognitive output is demonstrated.
findings.security: The main workflow has contents/issues/pull-requests write permissions and scheduled/push triggers despite no verified model collaboration.

changes: Quarantines Cross Analysis, Scheduler Tick and Merge Queue.
Makes eight external mutation workflows inert pending authorization and verified environment controls.
Replaces synthetic PingPong with a manual, read-only NOT_IMPLEMENTED status artifact.
Adds tests for the no-live-collaboration claim and safe manual-only workflow states.
unresolved: Two earlier push-event runs for task-allocator and force-deploy had zero jobs and no logs; the cause was not established.
The PR base is two commits behind current main; compare showed no current conflict, but no rebase was performed.

changes: Prevents mixed evaluation protocols from being pooled into misleading metrics.
limitations: No verified XRP forecasts or resolved outcomes have populated the ledger.
Feature snapshot bytes are not read and hash-verified by the ledger itself.
Source registry verification can be NOT_CHECKED when a registry is omitted.
Walk-forward, calibration and drift evaluation remain unimplemented or separate.

findings.limitation: Later metadata-only commits were JSON-syntax checked but not exact-head CI verified; new append-only files in this run require their own exact-head CI.
